prerequisites: EM1012 - Mecànica de Màquines i Estructures
EM1015 - Ciència i Tecnologia de Materials
EM1019 - Elasticitat i Resistència de Materials
EM1020 - Teoria de Màquines i Mecanismes

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to organize teamwork for industrial structures project within a given deadline.
Be able to calculate and dimension a metallic structure of an industrial construction using commercial software tools.
Be able to prepare a calculation project for an industrial structure.
Be able to dimension the resistant elements that make up an industrial steel structure based on current regulations.
Be able to dimension the simplest foundation elements of an industrial construction based on current regulations.
Be able to analyze the state of stress and deformation in simple foundation elements of a specific industrial construction.
Be able to analyze the state of stress and deformation in the resistant elements that make up a specific industrial steel structure.
Be able to describe the most common structural typologies in industrial building and the materials most commonly used in structural applications.
Know the current regulatory framework in the field of calculation and design of industrial structures.

syllabus_topics: Interior portal frame: beam and purlins
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum of 5 out of 10 points in the overall grade is required. The overall grade is calculated as 40% continuous assessment and 60% final exam. In the final exam, a minimum of 4.5 points is required in each part, and a minimum of 5 points overall. If any minimum is not met, the maximum final grade will be 4.5 and the course will not be passed. Continuous assessment requires attendance at laboratory sessions and submission of work; otherwise, 0 points will be awarded for this part. For the extraordinary completion of studies call, students who did not attend labs or submit work will be assessed solely on a 100% final exam.
